channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Francisco Garcia | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Francisco Garcia from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Aaron Goodwin on Francisco Garcia
item.description:
Agent Aaron Goodwin on Francisco Garcia returning to the Rockets:

“He liked the opportunity. He felt he could continue to help the team in a number of ways outside of just being a good guard on the team. He thought that he'd have an opportunity to play there a little bit more with Chandler Parsons being gone.”

Aaron Goodwin on Francisco Garcia, Aug 21, 2014. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Josh Powell, Francisco Garcia
item.description:
“At the same time, that’s why it takes guys like Francisco, Josh Powell, myself to know that nothing is promised. Guys who’ve been in the league for 15, 16 years didn’t get a ring.… Nothing’s promised, you know. We can’t take any moment, any series, any team, any minute on the court for granted. You gotta go at it. You gotta stay focused. You gotta stay positive.”

Dwight Howard on Josh Powell, Francisco Garcia, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Oregonian.

item.title: Patrick Patterson on Francisco Garcia, Thomas Robinson
item.description:
“They will add skill and depth along with the potential for a different look to our roster. We all want to thank Francisco, Thomas and Tyler for their efforts and contributions.”

Patrick Patterson on Francisco Garcia, Thomas Robinson, Feb 21, 2013. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Andrei Kirilenko on Francisco Garcia
item.description:
Andrei Kirilenko:

“Francisco Garcia said that he wants me to go to Sacramento. I replied 'Let's wait until the 11th'”

Andrei Kirilenko on Francisco Garcia, Jul 4, 2012. Source: Sport Express.
